licence.title: Physician Assistant licence
licence.renewalDeadline: Last day of the licensee's birth month, biennially (late renewal allowed for 3 months, then administratively revoked)

ce.categoryRules: Board approved = AMA Category 1, AOA Category 1, AAAA Category 1, AAFP Category I, or AAPA Category 1. At least 10 hours directly related to the specialty of the Board approved primary supervising physician. First renewal: 40 hours not required (prescriber 3 hours still required).

topicMandates.appliesTo: PAs authorized to issue prescription drug orders (within the 40; required even at first renewal; not waivable)

topicMandates.topic: Appropriate ordering and use of hydrocodone, oxycodone, and compounds
topicMandates.appliesTo: PAs authorized in their job description to order hydrocodone/oxycodone in emergencies (additional hour)

topicMandates.topic: Recognition and documentation of causes of death; execution of death certificates
topicMandates.appliesTo: PAs delegated authority to sign death certificates (additional hour)

ce.controlledSubstanceCe: No general controlled substance course for PAs found; 1 hour hydrocodone/oxycodone every renewal only for PAs delegated that Schedule II emergency authority.

practice.agreementFilingAndRenewal: Job description signed by the PA and primary supervising physician must be on file with and approved by the Board (360-5-.04(1),(5)); renewal for active practice requires a Board approved primary supervising physician and approved job description (360-5-.06(1)(c)). Under O.C.G.A. 43-34-103(c)(4), per the Board's 2024 statement, a new job description that attaches a substantially similar approved one is 'automatically deemed approved' on submission but still reviewed; all job descriptions must still be submitted. New delegations (hydrocodone/oxycodone in emergencies, death certificates) require a new job description (Form F).
practice.notes: Physician limit is the combined equivalent of eight PA job descriptions and APRN protocol agreements (2024 law per board statement). Rules 360-5-.07 and 360-5-.12 amended effective May 25, 2026.

prescribing.separateAuthorityRegistration: Prescriptive authority is delegated through the Board approved job description; PAs prescribing controlled substances must hold DEA registration and register with the Georgia PDMP within 30 days of obtaining a DEA number.
prescribing.ceForPrescribers: 3 hours practice specific pharmaceuticals every renewal; plus 1 hour hydrocodone/oxycodone if so delegated

rn.ceNote: 30 CE hours is one of five continuing competency options; maintained national certification, an accredited academic program, employer-verified competency with 500 practice hours, or other board-approved activity also satisfies it.
rn.renewalDeadline: January 31, biennially; even or odd year depends on the licence (RNs licensed on or after June 1, 2004 expire in the parity of the issue year; earlier licences by licence number parity). Rules 295-2-.05 and 295-2-.12. APRN authorization renews with the RN licence period.
rn.firstRenewalNote: Competency requirement deferred to the second renewal if the initial licence period is six months or less (Rule 410-13-.01(4)).

aprn.title: APRN (authorization to practice as a nurse practitioner)
aprn.separateLicenceOrCertificate: separate APRN authorization (two renewal applications: RN then APRN)
aprn.ceNote: No APRN-specific hour count in Board of Nursing rules; APRN must renew the RN licence (30 hour or alternative competency option) and maintain national certification.
aprn.pharmacologyNote: Delegating physician must ensure the APRN with delegated prescriptive authority receives pharmacology training at least annually (no hour number set).

prescribing.separateAuthorityRegistration: No separate prescriptive licence; prescriptive authority is delegated in the nurse protocol agreement filed with the Composite Medical Board.
prescribing.controlledSubstanceCe: 1 hour biennially hydrocodone/oxycodone only if delegated that authority; Schedule I and II otherwise excluded

practice.agreementType: nurse protocol agreement with a delegating physician
practice.agreementFilingAndRenewal: Delegating physician files the nurse protocol agreement with a Board form and fee with the Georgia Composite Medical Board, plus Board of Nursing verification (360-32-.03(1)-(2)); the agreement must be received within 30 days of execution (360-32-.03(6)); amendments filed within 30 days of execution (360-32-.02(1)(c), 360-32-.03(5)); reviewed, revised or updated annually (360-32-.02(11)); APRN DEA number provided to the Board within 30 days of issuance (360-32-.02(1)(a)1.); physician notifies the Board within 10 working days of termination (360-32-.05(5)); APRN notifies the Board within 7 days of the delegating physician's death or departure (360-32-.05(6)); annual onsite observation and quarterly record review by the delegating physician unless the 43-34-25(g.1) exception applies (360-32-.05(2)).

unverified: State controlled substance registration (PA and APRN): no Georgia practitioner CS registration found; PDMP registration within 30 days of DEA is confirmed for PAs (360-5-.12(3)) but not checked for APRNs. Left null.
Which January 31 (even or odd year) applies to a given RN depends on the licence; the app should take the expiry date from the licence rather than assume a year.
APRN national certification at renewal: 410-11-.03(6)(b) asks only for an attestation; maintaining certification is confirmed via 410-11-.10 discipline language, not a renewal submission.

Physician supervision limits: Board of Nursing Rule 410-11-.14(3) still says four APRNs per delegating physician; Medical Board Rule 360-32-.02(7)(b) allows a combined equivalent of eight at accredited (g.1) locations; the Board's 2024 statement describes a general combined eight under 43-34-103(b)(1). Statute text not loaded.
O.C.G.A. 43-34-103 and 43-34-25 statute text were not loaded; facts rely on current rules (current through Sept 2, 2026) and the Medical Board statement.
GA PA: no NCCPA-in-lieu provision exists in Rule 360-5-.07; acceptsNccpaCertificationInLieu=false is an inference from the rule text.
Federal DEA MATE 8 hour one-time training is federal, not Georgia law; not loaded in this verification.

np.rn.renewalDeadline: researcher presumed the next deadline is January 31, 2028 for everyone. Joint Secretary Rules 295-2-.05 and 295-2-.12 split RNs into even-year and odd-year January 31 cohorts by issue year (or licence number before June 2004). The board page's 'January 31, 2026' was one season, not a universal cycle. NP authorization coincides with the RN period (410-11-.03(6)(a)).

NP practice: researcher's DEA-within-30-days claim had no fact; now sourced (360-32-.02(1)(a)1.). Added the 30 day receipt deadline (360-32-.03(6)), 10 working day termination notice and 7 day death/departure notice (360-32-.05(5)-(6)), annual onsite observation and quarterly record review (360-32-.05(2)).

PA practice: researcher wrote that a job description is 'now deemed approved on filing'. The Board statement limits 'automatically deemed approved' to a new submission that attaches a substantially similar approved job description; all job descriptions must still be submitted and reviewed.

Checked missed mandates: the one-time 3 hour controlled substance CME and 2 hour professional boundaries training in Rule 360-15-.01 are physician-only (rule title 'Requirements for Physicians'); none found for PAs or APRNs in 360-5, 360-32 or 410 rules.
